reading: Adding the wrist camera to the v5a recipe (identical seeds, labels and physics) lifted the 50-episode quick check from 0.06 (v5a) / 0.12 (v4) / 0.14 (v3) to 0.84, with progress 0.91 and only 6 rejected steps (S3) in 2,355 frames: the centimetre misses the precision curves diagnosed are resolved by a view that shows the target relative to the fingertips — the Curse-of-Precision wrist-camera ablation (2607.23108) in the expected direction. Training cost 1.8x (0.51 vs 0.92 steps/s, 5.4 h, 7.1 GB VRAM) and loss ended at 0.589 (v5a 0.591): the loss did not predict the gain. The frozen 100-seed suite with variations and probes (session K) decides.
